'''Mikka Reekeene''', born in [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]], was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]]. He worked for [[Sartran Corporation/Legends|Sartran Corporation]] until he was arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], charged with [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. In [[Prison/Legends|jail]], Reekeene met and [[Marriage/Legends|married]] [[Lens Reekeene|Lens]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] leader. Reekeene was released and, as soon as he had the chance, freed Lens as well.

Along with his wife, Reekeene then joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and became Lens' second-in-command in [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], a guerrilla organization disturbing Imperial activities in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. With Lens having become a [[General/Legends|general]] and still in charge of the Roughnecks, Reekeene had the chance to work as an engineer in the Roughneck mobile headquarters, the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Home]]'', customizing it.

==Biography==
Mikka Reekeene was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] born in [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]]. As an adult, he became an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and [[Technician/Legends|mechanic]] and worked for [[Sartran Corporation/Legends|Sartran Corporation]] until [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]]. In that year, the governing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] dissolved the company, saying that it was involved in activities constitutive of [[Treason/Legends|treason]]. Reekeene was arrested and sent to [[Prison/Legends|jail]], where he met [[Lens Reekeene|Lens]], a former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] leader who had worked in a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] for Sartran until the Empire arrested her under false charges. Reekeene and Lens [[Marriage/Legends|married]] in prison.<ref name="CP" />

Reekeene was eventually released due to a mistake made by the prison management. Once free, he spent time getting [[Currency/Legends|money]] through any available means to set his wife free, and achieved this goal in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]. Once she had escaped, Lens discovered that most of the mercenaries she had commanded had died in jail. Eager to get revenge, Lens joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], wanting to create a military force that could fight the Imperials. To protect his wife, Reekeene joined the Alliance as well, although he was not as [[Politics/Legends|politically]] active as his wife.<ref name="CP" />

Soon, Lens became a high-ranking [[Alliance Military/Legends|officer]] of the Alliance, and Reekeene remained by her side as her [[Advisor/Legends|advisor]]. At some point, the Reekeenes were contacted by [[Santhou Lazith'chika]], a mysterious [[Alien/Legends|alien]] who managed to gain their trust. Lazith'chika became Mikka's main advisor and Lens' second main advisor. The Reekeenes and Lazith'chika then founded the [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], a guerrilla organization that harassed Imperial forces in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. They intended to attract Imperial attention, thus diverting the Empire's resources from combating the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance main fleet]].<ref name="CP" />

The Reekeenes and Lazith'chika were the highest-ranking members of the Roughnecks; they briefed the members of sub-teams and answered any questions. As a security measure, once briefed for a mission a member of the Roughnecks could not speak with anyone except for the Reekeenes or Lazith'chika until their task was complete. As the co-leader of the Roughnecks, Mikka used his empathy and caution as a counterpoint to his wife's aggressiveness. Mikka, who was also the chief engineer of the Roughnecks, modified their mobile headquarters, the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Transport/Legends|hauler]] ''[[Home]]'', adding a secret cargo hold in the starboard port. Mikka and Lens were the only two people who knew the course of the ''Home'' at any given time. Although most members of the Roughnecks wore a [[Color/Legends|colored]] armpatch identifying their [[Squad/Legends|squad]], the Reekeenes wore [[white]] patches because they were the [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]].<ref name="CP" />

Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a silent Reekeene joined his wife, Lazith'chika, and Rebel [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Am Serro]] aboard the ''Home'' to hear the report of special operative [[Tay Vanis|Tay "Tiree" Vanis']] twentieth operation. Vanis had failed to recruit some new agents and had also reached the mission limit before mandatory retirement. Nevertheless, Lens assigned him to a new job, and neither Mikka nor the other officers objected to this.<ref name="RR" />

==Personality and traits==
Mikka Reekeene was an engineer and mechanic, specializing in the maintenance of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] transports, [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor drives]], and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], with some skill in [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] transports. He commonly dressed in overalls and also carried tools and switches that he sometimes forgot while traveling. He harbored the wish of developing a [[hyperspace alternator sequencing module]] more than anything else. One of the few Humans able to speak the [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]] language, Reekeene was also prone to speaking in a strong, hardly understandable accent, particularly in moments of stress.<ref name="CP" />

Reekeene was married to Lens Reekeene and performed several tasks only for her sake, such as joining the Rebel Alliance. Lens, commonly seen as cold and detached, was warmer toward her husband. Mikka was known among the Roughnecks for his skill to emotionally know and share other people's feelings and for his prudent foresight. As of 0 ABY, Mikka was sixty years old and overweight, but was in considerably good shape.<ref name="CP" /> He also sported a full beard at this point.<ref name="RR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mikka Reekeene first appeared in the [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] book ''[[Star Wars Campaign Pack]]'', written by [[Paul Murphy]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1988]]. The book detailed "[[The Long Shot Campaign]]," a series of adventures for the players set in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. ''The Long Shot Campaign'' was later republished in [[1994]], along with another campaign, in ''[[Classic Campaigns]]''. Reekeene was first graphically depicted in the [[2006]] [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]'' by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="pablo">{{Blog|pablog|50|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Three Annotations}}</ref>
